patch_description: Consolidate the initial rotation layer from using "ry_even"/"ry_odd" (2 parameter names) to a single "ry" parameter applied uniformly across all 8 qubits. This reduces n_distinct_params from 6 to 5, improving parameter efficiency without sacrificing accuracy. The improvement targets the scoring metric which heavily penalizes parameter count. Since all top ansätze achieve perfect accuracy, parameter economy is the dominant differentiator for worst_group_margin and overall robustness.
